text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright, it's that time of the week 
again! Welcome to 'Ear-Twitching 
Nighttime's' comedy improv corner!”

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"We received so many answers to last 
week's topic~!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, bring it on! Radio handle: 
'La-La-La Big Sis'...!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep reading through them! The 
first response is—..."

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"—And that wraps up this week's Ogiri 
comedy showcase! Next, we'll announce the 
upcoming topic. Be sure to send in your 
submissions, everyone~!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Couldn't read it, huh. Well, guess it 
ain't gonna be that easy.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
But that's part of the learning process 
too. Let's head back to the drawing board 
and rethink our plan.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(This time for sure, come on! "La-La-La 
Big Sis"...!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep reading through them! First up 
—Radio name, Lalala's Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"'This alien seems kinda vulgar. What kind 
of alien is it?' Here's Big Sis La-La-La's 
answer!"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Asking for the nearest convenience store 
immediately upon arriving on Earth."

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, that's the first thing you say upon 
arrival?! How worldly, haha. ...Now then, 
next up is—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I got brushed off pretty easily, huh. 
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Should I add another twist to it...? No, 
maybe stripping it down would make it pop 
more?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Just getting them to read it is only half 
the battle. Next time, I've gotta make it 
truly resonate with them!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Our first caller is... Radio handle, 
La-La-La Big Sis! Thanks for calling in 
again!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch. —So, how'd it turn out 
this time?

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"'Name a terrible race commentary nobody 
wants to hear.' Here's Big Sis La-La-La's 
answer!"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"‘Whoaa, what happens here!? Tune in next 
time!!’"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, don't drag it out, don't drag it 
out! Just say it all in real time! Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, that commentary must have been 
rough! We'll be sending our special show 
keyholder to Lalala's Big Sis~!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...! Yes! All right...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lara. That keychain on your sports bag 
is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. ...This is one of my 
personal favorites.

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Our first caller is... Oh! Radio handle: 
La-La-La Big Sis! You're basically one of 
the regulars now, huh~?"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"'At the Kappa Derby, the heavy favorite 
stalls out around the fourth corner! What 
on earth happened?!' Here is Big Sis 
Lalala's answer!"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"I accidentally put out an antique Imari 
platter."

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, first of all, that plate has got to 
be huge! Did you seriously not notice 
until the final stretch?! —Nice answer, 
Lalala lady!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ Well then, look forward to the next 
one too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Yesterday's comedy bit was a big hit 
too... hehe.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A Kappa Derby... *pfft*! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (—!? Was that just now...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan, what are you listening to?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's the radio archive! The comedic improv 
section from yesterday was hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Especially that listener named "La-La-La 
Sis"—she's funny at a hundred miles an 
hour~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (—Wait, that's ME!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Aw man. Hearin' you say that makes me 
a hundred miles of happy too...!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Our first caller is... our familiar 
friend, radio handle, La-La-La Big Sis! 
We're all excited to hear what kind of 
hilarious jokes you've got for us 
tonight~!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you're settin' the bar way too high. 
...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(My answer yesterday went down real well 
with the DJ~)

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: Lady Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"These are archives of the radio show 
currently trending at the academy. May I 
play it for some entertainment?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: Hah! Well then—

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Our first caller is... our familiar 
friend, radio handle, La-La-La Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Huh? What... ?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Whaaaaaat!?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No way, no way, no way, absolutely no 
way!! Having them listen to my Ogiri 
comedy goes way beyond just "humbling"!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, jeez! My heart's pounding like crazy! 
Oh no! It's beating so fast I can hardly 
breathe...!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"'Sitting on this throne takes serious 
resolve...!' Why did the King think so? 
Here's Big Sis La-La-La's answer!"

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Looking closely, it's just a human 
pyramid made of his retainers."

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
""Wait a minute!? The throne is 
human-powered!? Forget the king, the 
retainers have way too much resolve 
here!!""

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted 
Lucky Lilac staggering around.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Th... There's nothin' there... There's 
nothin' there, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...*haaah*~~~~~!! Jeez! I can't stop 
grinning...!
